parsed_json.sql: SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, a.tid, a.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism, d.journal, d.year, d.volume, d.first_page, d.doi FROM assays a JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.assay_type = 'B' AND a.tid = 165 ORDER BY a.chembl_id, a.tid, d.journal, d.year, d.doi
